items.text: Epoch AI reports that 25% of August math arXiv preprints acknowledged AI, up from 4% in April.
items.text_zh: Epoch AI称，8月数学类arXiv预印本中25%承认使用AI，4月仅为4%。
items.cat_take_en: The rise signals AI is becoming research infrastructure, but acknowledgment still reveals usage rather than scientific value.
items.cat_take_zh: 比例上升说明AI正成为研究基础设施，但承认使用并不等于证明科学价值提升。

items.text: Pika launched Product Ad, an app that turns product imagery into creative advertising concepts rather than simple promotional montages.
items.text_zh: Pika推出Product Ad，可把产品素材转化为广告创意方案，而非仅生成宣传混剪。
items.cat_take_en: This moves generative video toward marketing ideation, benefiting small teams while increasing pressure on creative agencies.
items.cat_take_zh: 它把生成视频推进到营销创意阶段，小团队受益，但传统创意代理商压力也会增加。

items.text: NVIDIA introduced Dynamo AIPerf, a tool for measuring LLM time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, throughput, and latency under traffic.
items.text_zh: 英伟达推出Dynamo AIPerf，用于测量高流量下大模型首Token时间、Token间延迟、吞吐量和整体延迟。
items.cat_take_en: Standardized load testing can expose production bottlenecks, but it does not itself solve scarce GPU capacity or routing costs.
items.cat_take_zh: 统一压测能暴露生产瓶颈，却无法直接解决GPU紧缺或模型路由成本问题。

items.text: Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 claims first place among 32 streaming models while keeping streaming pricing at $0.20 per audio hour.
items.text_zh: Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0称在32个流式模型中准确率第一，流式转录价格仍为每音频小时0.20美元。
items.cat_take_en: Keeping price unchanged while improving accuracy strengthens voice-agent economics, though independent multilingual validation remains important.
items.cat_take_zh: 价格不变而准确率提升有利于语音智能体降本，但多语言独立验证仍不可缺少。

items.text: Google added new experts to its AI and Economy team to study how artificial intelligence reshapes markets and institutions.
items.text_zh: Google为AI与经济团队增聘专家，研究人工智能如何重塑市场与制度。
items.cat_take_en: Bringing economists into AI strategy may improve policy analysis, but corporate research still faces incentives around commercial conclusions.
items.cat_take_zh: 引入经济学家有助于提升政策分析，但企业研究仍可能受商业立场影响。

items.text: MiniMax opened its Code CLI, giving developers a command-line interface for using its coding model in local development workflows.
items.text_zh: MiniMax开放Code CLI，让开发者可在本地开发流程中通过命令行使用其编程模型。
items.cat_take_en: A CLI makes coding agents easier to script and automate, but adoption will depend on tool reliability and permissions safety.
items.cat_take_zh: 命令行接口便于编排和自动化编程智能体，但普及取决于可靠性与权限安全。

items.text: Runway added alpha-channel preservation to Ruby’s HDR conversion workflow, allowing transparent video elements to survive processing.
items.text_zh: Runway为Ruby新增Alpha通道保留能力，让透明视频元素在HDR转换后继续有效。
items.cat_take_en: Preserving transparency removes a practical compositing obstacle for studios, though it addresses workflow friction rather than generation quality.
items.cat_take_zh: 保留透明通道消除了制作合成中的实际障碍，但它改善的是流程而非生成质量。

items.text: OpenAI introduced Astra for Law, a GPT-6 Astra configuration with legal search and workflows aimed at firms and legal technology companies.
items.text_zh: OpenAI推出Astra for Law，这是面向律所和法律科技公司的GPT-6 Astra法律工作流版本。
items.cat_take_en: A legal-specific model could compress research time, but liability and jurisdiction-specific accuracy remain unresolved adoption barriers.
items.cat_take_zh: 法律专用模型或能压缩检索时间，但责任归属和法域准确性仍是落地障碍。

items.text: LlamaIndex began a Parsed by LlamaParse series examining how document parsing errors affect consequential AI systems.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex启动Parsed by LlamaParse系列，讨论文档解析错误如何影响高风险AI系统。
items.cat_take_en: Focusing on parsing exposes a neglected failure layer: retrieval quality can collapse before a language model ever reasons.
items.cat_take_zh: 聚焦解析揭示了常被忽视的故障层：模型推理前，检索质量就可能已经崩溃。

items.text: Replit expanded Free Mode to provide thirty times more usage, including additional chat, projects, designs, and slide decks.
items.text_zh: Replit将Free Mode用量扩大30倍，覆盖更多聊天、项目、设计和演示文稿额度。
items.cat_take_en: A large free-tier expansion can accelerate experimentation, but it may also increase infrastructure costs before paid conversion is proven.
items.cat_take_zh: 大幅扩大免费额度能加速试用，但付费转化尚未验证前也会增加基础设施成本。

items.text: PrismML released Ternary Bonsai 2 27B, an Apache-2.0 model reported at 5.9 GB while retaining 98.2% of Qwen3.8 27B performance.
items.text_zh: PrismML发布Apache-2.0许可的Ternary Bonsai 2 27B，体积5.9GB，据称保留Qwen3.8 27B性能的98.2%。
items.cat_take_en: A 5.9GB high-performing model could broaden local deployment, but the unusually strong benchmark claim needs independent replication.
items.cat_take_zh: 5.9GB且性能接近大模型有望扩大本地部署，但亮眼基准结果仍需独立复现。
